values: Frankfurt Expat Services — Provider Outreach Batch 1
Private working tracker • Research leads only • Verify availability and fit before any contact

1. Personal check: services, English capacity, audience fit, and current contact path.
2. Invite a short discovery conversation—not a paid placement.
3. Only introduce a provider after defined fit and transparent disclosure.
4. Editorial content and partner status remain separate.
5. Log every result; a polite “no” is useful market evidence.
Suggested sequence: validate 3 relocation providers → 3 tax advisers → 2 immigration firms → 2 insurance advisers. Stop and refine the pitch after the first three conversations.

values: Founding Provider Invitation — Send Only After Vetting
Subject: A free founding profile for Frankfurt’s international newcomers

Hello [Name],

I run Frankfurt Expat Services, a source-linked guide and directory for international newcomers settling in Frankfurt.

I’m inviting a small founding group of English-friendly [category] providers to receive a free, clearly labelled profile while I learn which referral paths are genuinely useful for newcomers.

We do not sell rankings, and a paid relationship will never influence our editorial guidance. If your team is accepting suitable international clients, would you be open to a 15-minute conversation? I’ll share the questions newcomers are asking, their language needs, and how I plan to qualify any future introductions.

Best,
Michael
Frankfurt Expat Services
